description: Canonical observer-only Tool-versus-selected-Project owner. External Project implementation, validation, release, and rollback remain Project-owned; KANDA source writes and KANDA validator/source-archive fallback are forbidden.
user_intent_examples: Resolve Tool and selected Project ownership before this mixed patch.
Prove the support root and source-write owner without collapsing self-hosting.
Block cross-project mutation while permitting declared comparison reads.
when_to_load: Route for consequential coding, patching, validation, freeze, handoff, migration, mixed Tool/Project writes, cross-project access, or any unresolved owner or write target. A compact startup bridge routes here.
when_not_to_load: The compact startup bridge is sufficient only for simple tasks with no consequential owner, path, write, or migration question.
do_not_regress: Do not collapse Tool and selected Project ownership, including self-hosting.
Do not treat slug or path-string equality as complete identity proof.
Do not place KANDA-managed Project Support inside Project source.
Do not let the transient workspace own durable truth.
Do not authorize coding from Q06 alone.
Do not duplicate MCard, Workbench, delivery, or durable-document contracts.
Do not silently merge support state after rename, move, or collision.
Do not allow undeclared or unauthorized cross-project mutation.
Do not create or refresh <project>-Windows-Portable.zip from Show Project to AI.
Portable builds require a separate explicit user request and productization/release workflow outside Project Support.

Require Fire Shield only when KANDA Reasoner or a KANDA-managed workflow is the actor touching an external Project; independent Project-owned IDE, terminal, CI, install, test, and validation work must not depend on KANDA selection, registry, portable runtime, Fire Shield, or Tool availability.
